cards.q: Why cell-cycle specific drugs are given in short pulses

cards.q: Kinetics of cell kill by cytotoxic drugs
cards.a: First-order: a fixed fraction of cells is killed per treatment

cards.q: Goal of cancer chemotherapy when possible
cards.a: Complete remission; drugs often used at maximum tolerated doses

cards.q: When intensive chemotherapy gives better results

cards.q: Childhood tumours that chemotherapy can cure or long-remit
